hibernate-mapping.query: from CrecheContract as f where f.contractNummer = :ContractNummer
select f from CrecheContract as f where f.klantId = :KlantId order by f.contractPeriodeVan asc, f.contractNummer asc
select f from CrecheContract as f where id in (:ids)
select distinct f from CrecheContract as f join f.crecheContractRegels as ccr join ccr.dierId as d join f.klantId as k where f.actief is true
select count(klantId) from CrecheContract as c where c.klantId = :Id
select count(crechePrijsCategorieId) from CrecheContract as c where c.crechePrijsCategorieId = :Id
